Welcome to the 8th edition of Weekly Tidbits by Markets by Zerodha, where we bring you interesting stories that may not make it to a full Daily Brief but still deserve a closer look.
In this edition of Weekly Tidbits, we cover 12 stories across Global, Economy, Industry and Company (GEIC) — from France’s rising borrowing costs and Japan’s slowing factory growth to India’s trade deal with New Zealand, the satellite internet debate, and major corporate investments.
